verdicts.rationale: The change adds an @lru_cache(maxsize=1024) decorator to `is_excluded`. The `maxsize` argument was introduced in Python 3.9; on earlier versions the decorator call itself raises a TypeError, causing the function to fail when invoked. The PR does not include any tests, docs, or changelog entries to justify or guard this change.
